narrative:
Summit County has 374,925 registered voters, with 16.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 16.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 55.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 38.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.6% of registrants.
